WEBFISHING is one of those chatroom type of games where you hang out with friends as the game serves more of a medium for conversations to take place. The game executes this very well, it's centered around fishing and feels very cozy, with some secrets to find and a lot of customization for your character.

Unfortunately the game has stopped receiving updates as the developer has received blatantly unwarranted hate. I feel the game would have remained popular for much longer if it continued to receive necessary updates as it's a very small-scale indie project gone viral, so it's sad to see that the actions of a few caused this to stop getting the love it deserved to get.

What we're left with is ultimately a really fun way to pass the time while hanging out with friends, I strongly suggest avoiding public lobbies however as some security issues remain. I think the singleplayer experience is perfectly suitable on its own, if you have something to half-watch while playing.

My only regret with this game is that I was busy when the game was at its peak and everyone was playing it, as I feel I would've put in so much more hours if I was more available. This is a nice little game.

Webfishing... where do i start,

This game, at first glance, may look like a basic fishing game but, I, myself do not like fishing so i was sceptical about the buy first, but as this game is only $5, i bought it anyway. This was one of the best purchases.

As i previously stated i said i do not like fishing games but i gave this a try. This game IS NOT only fishing this game includes way more. There are many customisation options, different things to do ( Gambling, hanging out, etc) . But most importantly, the people we meet along the way. This game is also a social hangout and the people in this game are very nice and friendly. Almost everyone i met, gave me tips and had awesome conversations with me. They are all just so chill.

This game is a must buy. If you are sceptical like I once was, please dont be and get this game, it's a steal for the low price of $5.And also, if you have anyone you play loads of games with, then please get this for them or tell them to get it too as this is a lovely multiplayer experience.

WEBFISHING was a nice change of pace when I first played it. A cozy game whose main selling point is hanging out with friends or strangers online while you fish together. It's a shame then that the game is now abandoned by its developer. While I didn't play an awful lot of this game, the memories I made with my friends on here made it worth it. 

There isn't a lot to do in WEBFISHING outside of catching fish, but that's perfectly fine. This isn't a game that you need to sink hundreds of hours into. There's enough fish in the game to keep you busy.

Overall, I think this game is great, and it was nice while it lasted.

Websfishing by lamedeveloper is an absolute gem in the indie game world! This game offers a unique and engaging fishing experience that’s both relaxing and thrilling. The graphics are stunning in its own stylized way, bringing the underwater world to life with vibrant colors and unique details. The gameplay is smooth and intuitive, making it easy for both beginners and seasoned gamers to dive right in.

The variety of fish and locations keeps the game interesting and challenging. Every catch feels rewarding, and the upgrade system allows for constant progression and customization. The soundtrack is serene and perfectly complements the tranquil nature of the game.

I particularly love how Websfishing incorporates unexpected elements like treasure hunts and rare species, adding layers of excitement and surprise to every session. The developers have done a fantastic job of balancing simplicity with depth, making it a game you can enjoy for short breaks or long play sessions.

tldr.text: Overwhelmingly Positive (97%) on Steam, but recent reviews from the last 30 days are noticeably less positive.
Players love the co-op and the friendly community, but some complain about the developers and updates.

details.text: Newer players are less positive than mid-level players: 91% of those with under two hours are positive, against 98% of those with two to ten hours.
Complaints about developers and updates appear in 8% of reviews, such as one saying "the dev has abandoned the game" and hackers are rampant, so buyers should weigh that risk.
